Under legacy semantics, `chosen_layout()` resolves the default `"auto"` to `"multiindex"`, and explicitly selecting `"multiindex"` has the same effect. In both cases, `model_snapshots(n, sns)` returns `sns` unchanged, so the added assignment in `create_model` does not change the snapshots passed to the variable and constraint builders; changes inside those builders do not satisfy this criterion.
